title: First-layer gate characterization
statement: Let $m\ge 7$, let $x$ be a sign string with $2^m$ coordinates, and let $i$ index one of the $m2^{2m}$ first-layer gates. Decompose $i$ through the specified indexing bijection into a block index $b\in\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$ and a sign assignment $a$ on $2m$ positions. The corresponding AND gate in the first layer outputs $-1$ exactly when $a$ agrees at every position with the restriction of $x$ to the coordinates selected for block $b$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign string with $2^m$ coordinates
